## GTA 6 PS5 Version Gets a Limited-Time Discount

For players eagerly tracking every update surrounding Grand Theft Auto 6, finding early deals or price breaks is always a pleasant surprise. Recently, major gaming media outlet IGN Games reported a special limited-time promotional opportunity for those planning to purchase GTA 6 on the PlayStation 5 platform.

According to the report published by IGN Games on September 15, 2026, players have the chance to save $11 on the PS5 version of Grand Theft Auto 6. However, there is a catch that requires immediate attention: this exclusive price reduction is valid **today only**. By following a few straightforward steps highlighted by the publication, eligible buyers can secure this discount before the window closes.

## What This Means for PlayStation 5 Players

Discounts on blockbuster titles—especially anticipated behemoths like GTA 6—are rarely seen in such a straightforward manner during promotional cycles. For PS5 owners who have already made up their minds about diving into Rockstar Games' upcoming open-world masterpiece, saving $11 today provides an extra incentive to finalize their purchase plans.

As the gaming community continues to monitor all media drops and retail updates, taking advantage of verified media-partner promotions remains one of the most reliable ways to get a head start on upcoming releases without paying full MSRP.

## Editor's Take

While an $11 saving might seem modest for a monumental title like GTA 6, any discount on day one or during early promotional windows is a welcome win for gamers. If you are planning to play on the PS5, it is definitely worth checking out IGN's guide today before this limited-time offer expires.
